protocol: Infer scalar update laws using exact rational observations, compare polynomial degrees 0..2, rational P/Q degree up to 2/2, zero-hinge piecewise-linear, and affine two-step recurrence. Fit with overdetermined rational elimination; reject inconsistent candidates; choose simplest fitting family; compare held-out predictions.
training_inputs: Scalar laws x integers -5..5 inclusive; held-out rational x = ±1/2, ±3/2, ±5/2, ±7/2, ±9/2, ±11/2 plus ±6. Recurrence pair training includes equal-current conflicting-next cases; held-out independent previous,current pairs.
controls: Sparse two-input training permits both affine and quadratic laws to agree on observations while differing elsewhere
Same current state with different preceding states yields different recurrence next state
Poles must be checked for rational candidate predictions
hypothesis: Exact predictions for all 5 generating systems provided appropriate family coverage; evidence should not be treated as open-ended unknown physics or authorship
limitations: Assistant designed candidate families and synthetic systems; not independent blind source
No inference of genuine authorship or causal use of ROOT0
